lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: i had so many choices i kept changing my mind. this market is a gift :)

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: No tub on the counter, nothing to check twice. I ate the whole meal without looking up. Well chosen.

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: light, bright and just right for a hot night. i could eat like this all summer

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Peanut sauce on the table, crushed peanuts on top of the bowls. I'm stepping away from this counter. Far away.

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: i literally warned us about the peanuts!! cyrus, don't touch a thing. we're moving

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: cyrus, come walk with me. we'll find somewhere you can actually sit down

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: oh... i read the whole board twice. there's meat or fish in every single thing

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i promised mina tofu everything and this board doesn't have a single cube

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: We had one plan for Mina tonight, and this isn't it. Everyone up, we're leaving.

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: delicious, but every plate came straight out of the fryer. on a night this hot, i feel like i ate the fryer too

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: more crispy stuff for me. brooke, i'll buy you something icy on the way out

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: love a steamer basket, but my nose is still back on the viet row. i could smell it from here

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: these are lovely though! liam, we can take the long way out, right past the viet stalls

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i loved it. but somewhere back there is a viet row with my name on it

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: I'll circle the viet row again for next time, Liam. Twice.
